items.statement: Fewer than 70 percent of eligible patients receive pre-hospital tranexamic acid within three hours of injury, with lower administration for single-paramedic attendance and patients over 65.
items.rationale: Directly measurable from ambulance records under the approved audit; the retrieved rural service found 58 percent.
items.risks: Estimated injury times; eligibility judged from records.

items.statement: Among patients linked to hospital records, treatment within one hour is associated with lower 30-day mortality than later or no treatment.
items.rationale: Only testable if the agreement is renewed; feasibility is not rated because it depends on a decision outside the team.
items.risks: Confounding by severity and selective linkage.

summary: Two hypotheses; h1 selected because it can be answered with the data the network may use now.
